from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
import numpy as np
s='[c-]1([Si](C)(C)CC[Si](C)(C)[c-]2c(C)c(C)c(C)c2C)c(C)c(C)c(C)c1C'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(s))
ring1=[0,18,20,22,24];ring2=[9,10,12,14,16]
coord={}
for ring,sgn in [(ring1,1),(ring2,-1)]:
 center=np.array([-.83,0,sgn*1.84]); e1=np.array([-1.84,0,-sgn*.83]);e1/=np.linalg.norm(e1);e2=np.array([0,1,0])
 for k,i in enumerate(ring):
  ang=2*np.pi*k/5+sgn*np.deg2rad(35)
  v=center+1.21*(np.cos(ang)*e1+np.sin(ang)*e2)
  coord[i]=Point3D(*v)
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3();p.randomSeed=60;p.useRandomCoords=True;p.SetCoordMap(coord)
ret=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p);print('embed',ret)
if ret<0: raise RuntimeError('embedding failed')
ff=AllChem.UFFGetMoleculeForceField(m)
for i in coord: ff.AddFixedPoint(i)
ff.Initialize();print('uff minimize',ff.Minimize(maxIts=4000))
ligcoords=np.array(m.GetConformer().GetPositions())
# adamantoxide aligned outward +x by vector from oxygen to bonded carbon
q=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('[O-]C12CC3CC(CC(C3)C1)C2'))
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3();p.randomSeed=78
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(q,p);AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(q,maxIters=1000)
v=np.array(q.GetConformer().GetPositions());v-=v[0]
a=v[1]/np.linalg.norm(v[1]);b=np.array([1.,0.,0.]);axis=np.cross(a,b);sin=np.linalg.norm(axis);cos=np.dot(a,b)
K=np.array([[0,-axis[2],axis[1]],[axis[2],0,-axis[0]],[-axis[1],axis[0],0]])
R=np.eye(3)+K+K@K/(1+cos)
v=v@R.T+np.array([1.85,0,0])
atoms=[a.GetSymbol() for a in m.GetAtoms()]+[a.GetSymbol() for a in q.GetAtoms()]+['Ti']
xyz=np.vstack([ligcoords,v,[0,0,0]])
with open('initial.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{len(atoms)}\nAnsa bis(tetramethylcyclopentadienyl) titanium(III) adamantoxide, doublet\n')
 for a,pos in zip(atoms,xyz):f.write(a+' '+' '.join(f'{x:.8f}' for x in pos)+'\n')
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'ligand.mol')
np.savez('moldata.npz',symbols=np.array(atoms),coords=xyz,ring1=ring1,ring2=ring2)
print('formula',Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m),Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(q),'+ Ti','atoms',len(atoms))
print('ringpos',[(i,ligcoords[i]) for i in ring1+ring2]);print('si',ligcoords[1],ligcoords[6])
PY

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
s='[c-]1([Si](C)(C)CC[Si](C)(C)[c-]2c(C)c(C)c(C)c2C)c(C)c(C)c(C)c1C'
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)
ring1=[0,18,20,22,24];ring2=[9,10,12,14,16]
xyz=np.zeros((m.GetNumAtoms(),3));fixed=[]
for ring,sgn in [(ring1,1),(ring2,-1)]:
 center=np.array([-.83,0,sgn*1.84]); e1=np.array([-1.84,0,-sgn*.83]);e1/=np.linalg.norm(e1);e2=np.array([0,1,0])
 for k,i in enumerate(ring):
  ang=2*np.pi*k/5+sgn*np.deg2rad(35)
  radial=np.cos(ang)*e1+np.sin(ang)*e2
  xyz[i]=center+1.21*radial;fixed.append(i)
  j=[a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors() if a.GetIdx() not in ring][0]
  xyz[j]=xyz[i]+(1.88 if m.GetAtomWithIdx(j).GetSymbol()=='Si' else 1.50)*radial
xyz[4]=[-4.40,.66,.37];xyz[5]=[-4.40,-.66,-.37]
for si,cp,bridge,me1,me2 in [(1,0,4,2,3),(6,9,5,7,8)]:
 u=xyz[cp]-xyz[si];u/=np.linalg.norm(u);v=xyz[bridge]-xyz[si];v/=np.linalg.norm(v)
 w=-(u+v);w/=np.linalg.norm(w);n=np.cross(u,v);n/=np.linalg.norm(n)
 for me,sign in [(me1,1),(me2,-1)]:
  xyz[me]=xyz[si]+1.88*(np.sqrt(1/3)*w+sign*np.sqrt(2/3)*n)
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for i,v in enumerate(xyz):conf.SetAtomPosition(i,v)
m.AddConformer(conf)
m=Chem.AddHs(m,addCoords=True)
ff=AllChem.UFFGetMoleculeForceField(m)
for i in fixed:ff.AddFixedPoint(i)
ff.Initialize();print('uff minimize',ff.Minimize(maxIts=4000),flush=True)
ligcoords=np.array(m.GetConformer().GetPositions())
q=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('[O-]C12CC3CC(CC(C3)C1)C2'))
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3();p.randomSeed=78
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(q,p);AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(q,maxIters=1000)
v=np.array(q.GetConformer().GetPositions());v-=v[0]
a=v[1]/np.linalg.norm(v[1]);b=np.array([1.,0.,0.]);axis=np.cross(a,b);cos=np.dot(a,b)
K=np.array([[0,-axis[2],axis[1]],[axis[2],0,-axis[0]],[-axis[1],axis[0],0]])
R=np.eye(3)+K+K@K/(1+cos)
v=v@R.T+np.array([1.85,0,0])
atoms=[a.GetSymbol() for a in m.GetAtoms()]+[a.GetSymbol() for a in q.GetAtoms()]+['Ti']
xyz=np.vstack([ligcoords,v,[0,0,0]])
with open('initial.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{len(atoms)}\nAnsa bis(tetramethylcyclopentadienyl) titanium(III) adamantoxide, doublet\n')
 for a,pos in zip(atoms,xyz):f.write(a+' '+' '.join(f'{x:.8f}' for x in pos)+'\n')
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'ligand.mol')
np.savez('moldata.npz',symbols=np.array(atoms),coords=xyz,ring1=ring1,ring2=ring2)
print('formula',Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m),Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(q),'+ Ti','atoms',len(atoms))
print('si',ligcoords[1],ligcoords[6])
